acceptance_criteria: Principal/getAvailability handler implemented. 20-method smoke test passes.
close_reason: Added AvailabilityError enum, get_availability default trait method; created principal.rs with handle_principal_get_availability; registered as Principal/getAvailability; smoke test updated to 20 methods; 3+2=5 new tests; 26 pass; clippy clean
description:
**What:** Principal/getAvailability handler is entirely missing. Depends on BusyPeriod being added to jmap-calendars-types (JMAP-z2cy B1).

**Algorithm:**
1. Add AvailabilityError enum to backend.rs: NotFound, Forbidden, TooLarge, RateLimit, Other(E).
2. Add to CalendarsBackend:
   fn get_availability(&self, account_id: &Id, principal_id: &Id, utc_start: &str, utc_end: &str, show_details: bool, event_properties: Option<&[String]>) -> impl Future<Output = Result<Vec<BusyPeriod>, AvailabilityError<Self::Error>>> + Send;
   Default impl: returns empty vec.
3. Create src/principal.rs with handle_principal_get_availability:
   - Parse all §2.2 args (id, utcStart, utcEnd, showDetails default false, eventProperties).
   - Map AvailabilityError → JMAP errors: NotFound→notFound, Forbidden→forbidden, TooLarge→tooLarge.
   - Build response {"list": [...]}.
4. Register Principal/getAvailability in register_calendars_handlers.
5. Export from lib.rs.
6. Update smoke test to 20 methods.

**Tests:**
- Valid request → list with BusyPeriod objects. Oracle: §2.2.
- Unknown principal → notFound.
- Forbidden → forbidden.
- showDetails:false → event field null in BusyPeriods.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- Principal/getAvailability registered.
- cargo test -p jmap-calendars-server exits 0.
title: Implement Principal/getAvailability handler + BusyPeriod (§2.2)
